messages:
lina: Quick thread for tomorrow's dress rehearsal. Key items: run-of-show timing, vendor captions vs Zoom auto captions, clip gating rules for gated assets, and HubSpot property mapping for follow-ups.

evan: I can run the rehearsal and act as MC. Do we have a hard 60-minute slot or 75?

lina: 60 preferred. Suggest 45m content + 15m live Q&A. Rehearsal should be full 60 with panel mic checks.

priya: Captions: Zoom auto captions are okay for quick access but vendor captions (Rev/3Play) are more accurate. Which path for same-day replay?

captions-bot: NOTE: Vendor caption turnaround SLA: Rev machine+human timestamps ~6-8 hours; Rev verbatim human ~24 hours. Zoom auto available immediately but ~85% accurate.

dan: If we want same-day public replay, we can publish with Zoom auto and flag for post-process replacement. For gated enterprise assets, wait for vendor captions and replace files.

lina: Agreed. Workflow: publish public replay with auto captions + "updated transcript pending" banner. For gated downloads (whitepaper + full recording) replace with vendor captions within 24h.

sara-marketing: For HubSpot gating: record "attended" + company size field to determine asset access. If company size >=1000 OR role contains "Director"/"VP" -> show download form with extra qualifying questions. Otherwise, immediate replay.

priya: Can we minimize form friction? For enterprise gate show 3 fields: company, role, interested-in. Others get 1-click replay. Also include consent checkbox for EU.

evan: Run-of-show draft: 0:00-3:00 intro housekeeping, 3:00-30:00 main demo, 30:00-42:00 panel discussion, 42:00-60:00 live Q&A + CTA. Need to time checks at 28 and 40 minutes to wrap segments.

dan: I'll add markers in the recording so clipping is easier. We'll add chapter markers at segment starts in the export metadata.

lina: Clipping policy: marketing to own 3 hero clips (teaser, demo highlight, customer quote). Videoops to own long-form 10-15 min highlight for enterprise nurture. All clips get UTM tags and {clip_id}.

sara-marketing: Nurture sequence mapping: Attendee -> Day0 replay email; Day2 clip + blog; Day5 invite to demo; Enterprise attenders -> AE notify immediate. We'll map HubSpot lifecycle stage and assign owner.

captions-bot: Reminder: enable Zoom setting 'Store closed captions' and 'Allow host to assign captioners'. Recommend enabling for vendor caption integration.

priya: Also ask panelists to switch to wired ethernet and close heavy apps. Send them a minimal tech checklist (mic gain, headphones, lighting).

evan: I'll run a 15min tech check 24h before with all panelists. We'll record that session locally as well.

dan: Export plan: Zoom cloud -> S3 staging bucket -> process pipeline: normalize audio -> request vendor captions (if flagged) -> transcode clips -> upload to HubSpot. I will provide the pipeline ARN and runbook.

sara-marketing: HubSpot file lifecycle: temp hosting for replay (public) for 7 days if truncated; full recording replaced when vendor captions arrive. Files should be named with unix ts + campaign key.

lina: Analytics: track watch depth (0-25,25-50,50-75,75-100), clip CTR, and demo requests. Add hidden field on replay page to capture source utm_campaign so we can attribute.

priya: GDPR/EU: For EU registrants, store consent property and do not auto-enroll in marketing flows without explicit opt-in. Add a required consent checkbox on reg form.

evan: Anything about live stream? We plan to stream to YouTube as backup. Stream key is ephemeral. We'll disable public chat on YouTube to avoid noise.

dan: Security: make sure the S3 staging bucket has lifecycle rules and limited access. Use presigned URLs for HubSpot ingestion, never public buckets.

sara-marketing: Who clips first pass? Lina/marketing will pick timestamps within 6 hours. If not, videoops do it by 12h.

lina: Action items: evan run rehearsal + MC (owner), priya coordinate vendor caption order and EU consent check (owner), dan implement export pipeline + chunk markers (owner), sara-marketing configure HubSpot gating + nurture flows (owner). I'll send panelist checklist DM and rehearsal calendar invite now.

evan: ACK. I'll post the rehearsal recording link here after test.

priya: Ordering Rev for vendor captions now (order id TBD).

lina: Thanks team. Rehearsal start 9:00am PT tomorrow. Please be on mute and in the rehearsal channel 15m early. :thumbsup:
